test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the Census of India 2011, which of the following states has the highest Hindu population percentage of total population?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• It was delayed to 2022 and then further delayed to 2023 due to the COVID-19 pandemic in India.
 
• Following the postponement of deadline of freezing administrative boundaries to 30 June 2023, and owing to the general elections in 2024, the census can now only take place in late 2024.​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Hinduism is the largest religion in India. According to the 2011 Census of India, 96.3 crores people identify as Hindu, representing **79.8% of the country's population**.

 
 
• In **Himachal Pradesh, 95.17 %** of the population belongs to the Hindu community.
 
• While **Mizoram is with 2.75 %,** the lowest percentage of the Hindu population in the state.
 
• **Dadra and Nagar Haveli have 93.93 %** of the Hindu community which is the highest among UTs and **Lakshwdeep is with 2.77%** which is the lowest among the UTs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• About Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India

 
 
• Established in 1961 by the Government of India
 
• Works under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• Objective - To arrange, conduct, and analyze the results of the demographic surveys of India.
 
• Present Chairman - Vivek Joshi ( 1989 batch IAS officer).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The first census(1871) in India took place during the reign of 'Lord Mayo'.

 
 
• The regular census in India began in 1881 during the tenure of Lord Rippon.
 
• The Census Commissioner of the 2011 Census was C. Chandramouli.
 
• Lakshadweep is India's smallest union territory in terms of population.
 
• According to the 2011 census, India's population is 1210 million.
 
 

12
